tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the web for current information, news, or general knowledge. Use when the user asks about recent events, current prices, weather, news, or topics not covered by the internal knowledge base. Returns a summarized answer with citations from top search results.

query.description: The search query. Be specific and include key terms. For example: 'GST registration process India 2024' not just 'GST'.

tools.name: read_pdf
tools.description: Read and extract text from a local PDF file. Use when the user provides a PDF file path and wants to know its contents. Returns the full text (truncated to 50,000 characters). Best for single-document, one-off queries. For multiple PDFs or repeated queries, use RAG ingestion instead.

file_path.description: Absolute or relative path to the PDF file. Must end with .pdf extension.

tools.name: rag_search
tools.description: Search the internal knowledge base (ChromaDB) for government services information. Use for questions about Indian government schemes, GST, tax filing, legal procedures, official portals, forms, and compliance. Returns a synthesized answer with inline citations [1], [2] linking to source documents. Best for factual, policy, or procedural questions covered by crawled official sources.

query.description: The question or search query. Be specific: 'How to file GSTR-1 return' not 'GST returns'.

session_id.description: Optional session ID for conversation tracking and tracing.

user_id.description: Optional user ID for personalization and tracing.

tools.name: calculator
tools.description: Evaluate numeric arithmetic (+, -, *, /, %, **, parentheses). Use round(value, digits) for explicit rounding. Returns a canonical decimal result; never use for legal classification.

tools.name: tax_calculator
tools.description: Compute GST liability, composition levy, or eligible ITC from supplied figures. Arithmetic only: verify the applicable rate and Section 10/16/17 eligibility with authoritative evidence first. Returns a canonical decimal string.

amount.description: Taxable value or turnover for GST/composition; total input tax for ITC, in rupees.

rate_percent.description: Verified GST or composition rate as a percent; required except for ITC.

eligible_itc.description: Verified available ITC for gst_liability; default 0.

blocked_itc.description: Verified blocked portion for itc operation; default 0.

tools.name: compliance_calendar
tools.description: Calculate standard GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, AOC-4, PF or ESIC due dates from official guidance. Returns a dated baseline and source, with a reminder to check extensions. For AOC-4 provide AGM date; quarterly GSTR-3B needs the principal-place state or UT.

period.description: Tax or wage month YYYY-MM; quarter-end month YYYY-MM for quarterly GST; AGM date YYYY-MM-DD for AOC-4.

filing_frequency.description: GST filing frequency; defaults to monthly.

state.description: Principal-place state or UT, required for quarterly GSTR-3B.

company_type.description: AOC-4 company type; explicitly set ordinary for the standard rule.

tools.name: scheme_discovery
tools.description: Find plausible MSME schemes using the host-provided business profile. Results are candidates requiring eligibility verification, with source links; this tool cannot establish statutory eligibility.

query.description: Describe the business support sought, e.g. new enterprise subsidy or quality certification.
